title: Exclude public donor aggregates for P104 role 532
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator is independently reproduced #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

Role 532 has two incoming ADDs between its paid MOVEs 41176/41178/44611. Test whether an exact signed aggregate can replace both at either public endpoint of a direct 3→207 MOVE at 44611. Both independent methods agree on all 26 coefficients and both bank inventories. Coordinate 27 is +1 in the required aggregate and zero on every eligible row in both banks. The eight chart-3 donors and nine chart-207 donors are exhausted. No construction advanced.

The hypothetical 3+3+2→8 edit removes 34 paid positions across the signed 17 copies and retains 22,461 productive positions. Its optimistic one-edit credit is bounded above by 0.53373482346222227 raw, granting ancillary work free. Actual realized saving is zero.

## Task and overlap

#7383 supplies the exact same window with the original ADD partners fixed. This scope allows any unchanged public donor at the two endpoints. #7378 supplies a distinct two-write aggregate precedent on an owned helper. Canonical main was `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` at pre-submit refresh. The package records the exact word, caller, price and scope.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-three-move-public-aggregate-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay authenticates the #7383 manifest and exact native word, reproduces four receipts and rejects two altered dependencies. The research commit adds one package and uses the two existing #7257 CI fixes for the historical selected replay gap documented in #7371. The selected record is unchanged.

## Credit

#7383 supplies the priced triple and fixed-partner predecessor. #7355 supplies the forward rational row engine. #7338, #7368 and #7369 supply overlapping chronology evidence. #7334 and #7113 supply the literal word and signed caller. #7298 supplies the directed tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Owned role 1567, role 198 and changed clock or ownership contracts remain outside this test. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
